choose.otherwise:
<set-variable name="cachedTokens" value="@{
                var usage = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["usage"] as JObject;
                if (usage == null) { return 0; }
                var details = (usage["input_tokens_details"] ?? usage["prompt_tokens_details"]) as JObject;
                var cached = details == null ? null : details["cached_tokens"];
                if (cached == null || cached.Type == JTokenType.Null) { return 0; }
                return Math.Min((int)cached, (int)context.Variables["promptTokens"]);
            }" />
            
            <set-variable name="cachedSavingsMicroUsd" value="@{
                var cached = (int)context.Variables["cachedTokens"];
                if (cached == 0) { return 0; }
                var model = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", "");
                double inputPrice = -1, cachedPrice = -1;
                foreach (var entry in ((string)context.Variables["modelPricing"]).Split(';')) {
                    var parts = entry.Split('=');
                    if (parts.Length == 2 && parts[0].Trim().Equals(model, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                        inputPrice = double.Parse(parts[1].Split('/')[0].Trim());
                    }
                }
                foreach (var entry in ((string)context.Variables["cachedInputPricing"]).Split(';')) {
                    var parts = entry.Split('=');
                    if (parts.Length == 2 && parts[0].Trim().Equals(model, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                        cachedPrice = double.Parse(parts[1].Trim());
                    }
                }
                if (inputPrice < 0 || cachedPrice < 0 || cachedPrice >= inputPrice) { return 0; }
                return (int)Math.Floor(cached * (inputPrice - cachedPrice));
            }" />
